title: Generators identify the fibre
statement: The generator map bijects with the fibre over one.

proof.text: Use the universal presentation property to construct the canonical cokernel map and verify the exactness and fibre properties required by the Stacks 03AJ argument.

mathlib_searches.query: short exact sequence from universal presentation
mathlib_searches.results: no direct match; cokernel and ShortExact.mk are available

theorem extension_presentation_generator_bijOn (S : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u})
    {G : Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max u w + 1}} {T : Torsor G}
    (E : ExtensionPresentation.{u, w} S T) (U : S.Etaleᵒᵖ) :
    Set.BijOn (E.generator U) Set.univ
      {x | E.projection.hom.app U x = (toSheafify S.smallEtaleTopology
        ((Functor.const S.Etaleᵒᵖ).obj
          (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{max u w + 1} ℤ)))).app U ⟨1⟩}
